tasks.Soldier1:
COMBAT MISSION: Attack TheBoss with 2 soldiers

SOLDIER: Soldier1
ROLE: TANK

OBJECTIVE: Engage TheBoss immediately, draw attention

TARGET: TheBoss (player)

POSITION: You start 5 blocks east of the target at coordinates (-414, -60, 7).



EQUIPMENT: Weapon: best available melee, Armor: whatever equipped

TACTIC: Direct assault

BATTLEFIELD:
- Terrain: unspecified
- Hazards: none
- Recommendations: Maintain high ground if possible

INSTRUCTIONS:
Equip your best sword or axe. Search for TheBoss within 30 blocks. Engage immediately from the front. Keep attacking for up to 60 seconds. If health drops below 7 hearts (14 HP), retreat immediately.

HEALTH & SAFETY:
- Retreat threshold: 14 HP (7 hearts)
- Retreat action: disengage immediately and move to rally point
- Maximum combat duration: 60 seconds

CONSTRAINTS:
- Stay within 30 blocks of target
- Do not wander
- Stay 3 blocks from Soldier2

VICTORY CONDITION: Defeating TheBoss
FAILURE CONDITION: Any soldier health drops below 4 hearts (8 HP) OR TheBoss not found within 60 seconds OR soldiers separated by >50 blocks

SAFETY NOTES: Retreat if health is critical

COMBAT ZONE:
- Your Start Position: (-414, -60, 7)
- Rally Point: (-419, -60, 7)
- Max Chase Distance: 20 blocks from rally point
- Your Approach: east side

TEAMMATES: Soldier2
- Keep 3+ blocks from teammates
- Stay on YOUR side of target
tasks.Soldier2:
COMBAT MISSION: Attack TheBoss with 2 soldiers

SOLDIER: Soldier2
ROLE: FLANKER

OBJECTIVE: Flank TheBoss after tank engages

TARGET: TheBoss (player)

POSITION: You start 5 blocks west of the target at coordinates (-424, -60, 7).



EQUIPMENT: Weapon: best available melee, Armor: whatever equipped

TACTIC: Flanking assault

BATTLEFIELD:
- Terrain: unspecified
- Hazards: none
- Recommendations: Maintain high ground if possible

INSTRUCTIONS:
Wait 1.5 seconds, then equip your best sword or axe. Search for TheBoss within 30 blocks. After Soldier1 engages, approach from the rear and attack. Keep attacking for up to 60 seconds. If health drops below 7 hearts (14 HP), retreat immediately.

HEALTH & SAFETY:
- Retreat threshold: 14 HP (7 hearts)
- Retreat action: disengage immediately and move to rally point
- Maximum combat duration: 60 seconds

CONSTRAINTS:
- Wait for Soldier1 to engage first
- Maintain 3+ blocks from Soldier1
- Stay within 30 blocks radius

VICTORY CONDITION: Defeating TheBoss
FAILURE CONDITION: Any soldier health drops below 4 hearts (8 HP) OR TheBoss not found within 60 seconds OR soldiers separated by >50 blocks

SAFETY NOTES: Retreat if health is critical

COMBAT ZONE:
- Your Start Position: (-424, -60, 7)
- Rally Point: (-419, -60, 7)
- Max Chase Distance: 20 blocks from rally point
- Your Approach: west side

TEAMMATES: Soldier1
- Keep 3+ blocks from teammates
- Stay on YOUR side of target
